_doc: Code hooks: located in the EBOOT by masked instruction pattern ('word/mask'), index = which instruction in the pattern is hooked. kind 'value': after the instruction runs, rt = rt_hookval(c, id, rt). kind 'call': the jal at that instruction calls rt_hookcall(c, id, original_target) instead. kind 'entry': the function starting at that instruction becomes a thunk that calls rt_hookcall(c, id, original_body). Handlers are in runtime/game.c.

hooks.name: COPTER_LIFT_DT
hooks._doc: Tail Copter: each flap sets the lift time to dt * 4 (4 frames) and accelerates at 30/s while it lasts, so above 30 fps the climb shrank. The lift time is computed from at least 1/30 s, as on the PSP.

hooks.name: SIG_START_DT
hooks._doc: Signature move start (Tails' Tail Copter among others): lift time dt * 4 and an upward kick of 2 * dt * 30, both meant as 4 frames / one frame at 30 fps. Fed at least 1/30 s.

hooks.name: RACER_MOVE
hooks._doc: A racer's move step (racer, dt): pos += vel * dt, then the collide-and-slide pass. Above ~165 fps the steps get so short that a racer sliding into a concave corner (the bottom of a loop, a ramp into a wall) creeps toward it forever instead of crossing onto the next surface; see racer_move() in game.c.

hooks.name: BUILD_RACER_SLOT
hooks._doc: Race load: the call that builds a racer slot's scene nodes (once per racer, slots 14 and 15). Experimental extra racer: SR2_EXTRA_RACER=file (a racer file from tools/racergen.py) is loaded and built here too, right after the last racer.

hooks.name: TRACK_ENTITY_SECTION
hooks._doc: World update, per entity: finds the level section it is in and switches it off when that section is not loaded; the two racers (W+0x502C[0..1]) are exempt. The experimental extra racer is exempted too.

hooks.name: RACER_INPUT
hooks._doc: A racer's input step (input): reads the pad (source 0..3, all the same pad device at 0x089A4020) or zeros (negative source) into the racer's input. The experimental extra racer gets source 1, which reads player 2's pad through a second pad device.

hooks.name: CAMERA_UPDATE
hooks._doc: The race camera's per-frame step (camera, dt): follows the racer at camera+0x294. Split view runs it a second time on the second camera's state.

hooks.name: WORLD_DRAW
hooks._doc: Race render: draws the level and racers from the current camera (F_15a460(world)). Split view draws it once per view, each clipped to its part of the screen.

hooks.name: SHADOW_DRAW
hooks._doc: Race render, after the world: F_31300 draws from the current camera too. Split view draws it once per view.

hooks.name: EFFECT_DRAW
hooks._doc: Race render, after the world: F_30414 draws from the current camera too. Split view draws it once per view.
